content.rendered:
Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit. The words you speak today are seeds. Whatever grows from them is the harvest you will eat tomorrow.

The Gospel For Today | Wednesday, July 29, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.”
Proverbs 18:21 (NKJV)

Today’s Message

Solomon’s book of Proverbs collects the accumulated wisdom of a life spent watching how the human condition actually plays out. He has watched kings rise and fall. He has watched marriages flourish and collapse. He has watched fortunes grow and vanish. And when he arrives at chapter 18, he identifies one of the most underestimated instruments in the whole architecture of human life. The tongue. Death and life are in its power.

The Amplified Bible Classic Edition expands the verse with striking clarity: “Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they who indulge in it shall eat the fruit of it [for death or life]” (Proverbs 18:21 AMPC). Whatever you indulge in with your tongue, you will eat. The Passion Translation renders it: “Your words are so powerful that they will kill or give life, and the talkative person will reap the consequences” (Proverbs 18:21 TPT). Words are not neutral. Words plant. And the planter eats the harvest.

The New Testament amplifies this Old Testament wisdom. Jesus taught in Matthew 12:36-37 that we will give account for every idle word. James wrote a whole chapter on the tongue as a small rudder that turns a great ship. Paul instructed the church in Ephesians 4:29 to let no corrupt word proceed out of the mouth, but only what is good for building up. The whole New Testament witness aligns with Solomon’s ancient wisdom. What you speak matters. It is planting the harvest of your tomorrow.

For the believer walking in authority, this is not abstract. Every time you agree with fear out of your mouth, you are watering fear in your life. Every time you agree with sickness out of your mouth, you are watering sickness in your body. Every time you speak defeat over your family, your finances, or your future, you are planting seeds of what you say. Every time you speak in agreement with the Word of God over your life, you are planting seeds of what God says. And the harvest, in either direction, is exactly what you eat. The believer with spiritual authority is the believer who has learned to plant with their words what heaven has already promised.

For Gospelbuzz readers, the truth today is practical. Guard your tongue. Watch what you speak. Refuse to indulge in words that agree with the enemy’s plan for your life. Practise, out loud, agreeing with what God has said. Your children hear you. Your spouse hears you. Your own heart hears you. And the spiritual realm around you hears you. Every word is a seed. Plant well today.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that death and life are in the power of my tongue. I choose life today. I refuse to indulge in words that agree with the enemy’s plan for my life, my family, my calling. I speak what You have said over my life. I speak Your promises. I speak Your blessing. I speak Your Word. My tongue is planting today, and the harvest I will eat tomorrow is the harvest of what I say now. Let my mouth be Your instrument, sowing life in every direction. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

Death and life are in the power of my tongue. I choose life today. I speak what God has said. My words are seeds. The harvest I eat will be the harvest of the Word I speak.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • James 3:2-12 (NKJV): The tongue as a small rudder and a fire
  • Matthew 12:36-37 (NKJV): By your words you will be justified
  • Ephesians 4:29 (NKJV): Let no corrupt word proceed out of your mouth
